questions.question: The sum of three consecutive odd numbers is always divisible by ______.
questions.solution:
Let, three consecutive odd numbers are x – 2, x and x + 2

∴ Sum of three consecutive odd numbers,

⇒ x – 2 + x + x + 2 = 3x

∴ Sum of three consecutive odd numbers is always divisible by 3.

questions.question: A boy added all natural numbers from 1 to 20. However he added one number twice, due to which the sum becomes 215. What is the number which he added twice?
questions.solution:
Let, the number he added twice = x

Sum of all natural numbers from 1 to 20,

⇒ 20 × (20 + 1)/2

⇒ 10 × 21

⇒ 210

According to problem,

⇒ 210 + x = 215

⇒ x = 5

questions.question: 6/7 part of a tank is filled with oil. After taking out 60 litres of oil the tank is 4/5 part full. What is the capacity (in litres) of the tank?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the capacity of the tank be x litre

According to problem,

⇒ 6x/7 – 60 = 4x/5

⇒ 6x/7 – 4x/5 = 60

⇒ (30x – 28x)/35 = 60

⇒ 2x = 60 × 35

⇒ x = 2100/2

⇒ x = 1050

**∴ The capacity of the tank is 1050 litres**

questions.question: P, Q and R together can complete a work in 40 days. P and Q together can complete the same work in 90 days. Then R alone can complete the same work in how many days?
questions.solution:
(P + Q + R) can complete a work in = 40 days

∴ (P + Q + R)’s 1 day’s work = 1/40 ….. (1)

(P + Q) can complete a work in = 90 days

∴ (P + Q)’s 1 day’s work = 1/90 ..... (2)

From (1) and (2) we get,

∴ R’s 1 day’s work,

⇒ 1/40 – 1/90

⇒ (9 – 4)/360

⇒ 5/360

⇒ 1/72

∴ R can complete the work in = 72 days

questions.question: An article which has a marked price Rs 2400 is sold for Rs. 1872. What is the discount percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

Marked price = Rs. 2400

Selling price = Rs. 1872

**Formula:**

Profit = SP - CP

Profit % = (Profit/CP) × 100

Discount = MP - SP

Discount % = Discount/MP × 100

**Calculations: **

∴ Discount percentage = [(2400 – 1872)/2400] × 100 = (528/2400) × 100% = 22%

questions.question: Average of 36 results is 18. If 2 is subtracted from each result, then what will be the new average of the results?
questions.solution:
Average of 36 results = 18

∵ Sum of 36 results = 36 × 18 = 648

Let, new average = x

According to the problem,

⇒ 36x = 648 - 36 × 2

⇒ 36x = 648 - 72

⇒ 36x = 576

⇒ x = 16

∴ New average = 16

**TRICK:**

If same change is made in each of the Quantity then the same change also appears in the Average.

here for Example-

2 is subtracted from each Quantity than for final average we can directly subtract 2 from average to calculate final average

= 18 - 2 = 16

questions.question: The average marks obtained by 140 students in an examination is 90. If the average marks of students who passed the examination are 120 and the number of students who failed the examination is 90, then what are the average marks of the students who failed the examination?
questions.solution:
Let the average marks of the failed student be x.

Total students = 140

The number of students who failed = 90

∴ The number of students who passed = 140 - 90 = 50

According to problem,

⇒ 90x + 50 × 120 = 140 × 90

⇒ 90x + 6000 = 12600

⇒ x = 73.33

∴ The average marks of student who failed = 73.33

questions.question: A shopkeeper professes to sell his goods at cost price but uses a 930 gm. weight instead of 1 kilogram weight. What will be the profit percentage of the shopkeeper?
questions.solution:
Let, cost price = Rs. x/kg

∴ Cost price of 930 gm. = x × (930/1000) = Rs. 0.93x

Selling price of 930 gm. = Rs. x

∴ Profit percentage = [(x - 0.93x)/0.93x] × 100 = (0.07/0.93) × 100% = 7.53%

questions.question: The cost of pencil is 33.33% less than the cost price of a pen. If a man sells 4 pencils at the cost price of 5 pens, then what is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Let, cost of a pen = 3x

∴ Cost price of a pencil,

⇒ 3x - [3x × (100/300)]

⇒ 3x - x

⇒ 2x

∴ Cost price of 4 pencil = 4 × 2x = 8x

∴ Selling price of 4 pencil = 5 × 3x = 15x

∴ Profit percentage = [(15x - 8x)/8x] × 100 = 7/8 × 100 = 87.5%

questions.question: If the radius of a circle is increased by 50%, then what will be the percentage increase in the area of circle?
questions.solution:
Let, original radius = r

∴ Original area = πr²

Radius after increase of 50% = r + r × 50/100 = 1.5r

∴ New area = π × (1.5r)²= π × 2.25r²

∴ percentage increase in the area of circle = [(2.25πr² - πr²)/πr²] × 100

⇒ 1.25/1 × 100%

⇒ 125%

questions.question: If the height of cylinder is increased by 35% and radius is increased by 10%, then what will be the percentage increase in curved surface area of cylinder?
questions.solution:
Let, original height = h

Original radius = r

∴ Curved surface area of the cylinder = 2πrh

After 35% increase, height = h + h × 35/100 = 1.35h

After 10% increase, radius = r + r × 10/100 = 1.1r

∴ New curved surface area of the cylinder = 2π × 1.1r × 1.35h = 2.97πrh

∴ Percentage increase in the curved surface area of the cylinder = [(2.97πrh - 2πrh)/2πrh] × 100

⇒ 0.97/2 × 100% = 48.5%

questions.question: A boat goes 2 km upstream and 3 km downstream in 20 minutes. Later it goes 7 km upstream and 2 km downstream in 53 minutes. What is speed (in km/h) of the boat in still water?
questions.solution:
Let, upstream speed = x km/h and downstream speed = y km/h

A boat goes 2 km upstream and 3 km downstream in 20 minutes.

According to problem,

⇒ 2/x + 3/y = 20/60

⇒ 120/x + 180/y = 20

⇒ 240/x + 360/y = 40 ……….. (1) [Multiplying by 2 on both sides]

The boat goes 7 km upstream and 2 km downstream in 53 minutes.

According to problem,

⇒ 7/x + 2/y = 53/60

⇒ 420/x + 120/y = 53

⇒ 1260/x + 360/y = 159 …….. (2) [Multiplying by 3 on both sides]

From (2) – (1) we get,

⇒ 1260/x – 240/x = 159 – 40

⇒ 1020/x = 119

⇒ x = 1020/119

⇒ x = 60/7

Putting the value of x in (1) we get,

⇒ 240 × (7/60) + 360/y = 40

⇒ 360/y = 40 – 28

⇒ 360/y = 12

⇒ y = 360/12

⇒ y = 30

∴ Upstream speed = (60/7) km/h and downstream speed = 30 km/h

∴ Speed of the boat in still water = [(60/7) + 30]/2 = (270/14) km/h = 135/7 km/

questions.question: A certain sum becomes 5 times in 3 years, at simple interest, then in how many years it will become 13 times?
questions.solution:
Let, amount = P and rate = r%

In first case,

Time = 3 years

Amount = 5P

According to problem,

⇒ (P × r × 3)/100 = 5P – P

⇒ 3Pr/100 = 4P

⇒ r = 400/3

In second case,

Rate = (400/3) %

Let, time = n years

Amount = 13P

According to problem,

⇒ [P × (400/3) × n]/100 = 13P – P

⇒ 4Pn/3 = 12P

⇒ 4n/3 = 12

⇒ n = 12 × ¾

⇒ n = 9

∴In 9 years it will become 13 times.

questions.question: If the height of a given cone becomes four times and the radius of the base becomes twice, then what is the ratio of the volume of the given cone and the volume of the new cone
questions.solution:
Let, original height of cone = h

Original radius of the base = r

∴ Volume of the cone = πr²h/3

New height of the cone = 4h

New radius of the base = 2r

∴ New volume of the cone = π × (2r)² × 4h/3 = 16πr²h/3

∴Required ratio = πr²h/3 ∶ 16πr²h/3

⇒ 1 ∶ 16
